notes: Product taxonomy used by the ComplyVision rule engine. Each category names the laws that govern its label, the measure the net quantity must be declared in (LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 12(2) and the Fourth Schedule, as amended up to G.S.R. 722(E) of 06.10.2023) and the tags the rule catalog (lm_rules.csv) selects on. Mirrors public.product_categories in Supabase (supabase/rule_engine.sql, generated by tools/export_catalog_sql.py).

tag_glossary.food: Food article - Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020 apply (LM Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation III)
tag_glossary.perishable: May become unfit for consumption or use after a period - best before / use by / expiry required (LM Rule 6(1)(da))
tag_glossary.ingredients_exempt: Single-ingredient or otherwise exempt from an ingredient list (FSS (L&D) Regulations, 2020)
tag_glossary.nutrition_exempt: Exempt from nutritional information (single-ingredient, herbs & spices, tea, coffee, water, alcohol, fresh produce)
tag_glossary.veg_dot_optional: Green / red-brown dot permitted at the top of the principal display panel (LM Rule 6(4A)(d), inserted 21.09.2026)
tag_glossary.third_schedule: 'When packed' qualifier permitted (LM Rule 11(4), Third Schedule: soaps, lotions, creams)
tag_glossary.lm_exempt: Outside the LM (PC) Rules - DPCO 2013 formulations (Rule 26(c)); the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 govern the label
tag_glossary.qr_allowed: Address, generic name and dimensions may be given through a QR code (Rule 6(1)(a),(b),(f) and 6(2) provisos, G.S.R. 456(E) of 23.06.2023)
tag_glossary.mfg_date_exempt: No month and year of manufacture required (Rule 6(1)(g) proviso A, Seeds Act proviso)
tag_glossary.mrp_exempt: No retail sale price required (Rule 6(1)(g) proviso C)
tag_glossary.excise_price: Retail sale price and unit sale price are governed by the State Excise laws (Rule 6(1)(e) and 6(11) provisos)
tag_glossary.bulk_50kg: Chapter II applies to bags up to 50 kg (Rule 3(b), as substituted 2017)
tag_glossary.no_small_pack_exemption: The 10 g / 10 ml exemption of Rule 26(a) does not apply (tobacco - G.S.R. 385(E) 2015; pan masala - G.S.R. 881(E) 2025)
tag_glossary.font_rules_mdr: Numeral / letter size governed by the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 (Rule 7(2),(3) provisos, G.S.R. 778(E) of 23.10.2025)
tag_glossary.veg_mark_food: Food article requiring the veg / non-veg symbol
tag_glossary.cosmetic: Cosmetic or toiletry - Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and Cosmetics Rules, 2020
tag_glossary.drug: Allopathic medicine - Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945
tag_glossary.ayush: Ayurveda, Siddha or Unani medicine - Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.161
tag_glossary.electronic: Electronic product - QR-code provisos and BIS registration
tag_glossary.size_relevant: Size relevant to the purchase - Rule 6(1)(f)
tag_glossary.bis_qco: Product under a BIS Quality Control Order
tag_glossary.bis_crs: Electronics under the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme
